provenance.usage_policy: known completed logical calls; unresolved provider attempt reservations remain in the cumulative gateway ledger
provenance.sampling_policy: identical prompts with provider defaults, no assumed diversity

dataset.name: Texa Research Benchmark v3 clarification revision 1

protocol_revision.change_reason: User/source-scope knowledge is now supplied equally to Texa and the schema-only interactive baseline via ui_scope. The previous metric-ambiguity questions about customers were invalid because the live catalog maps customer wording to users; this revision replaces those 15 pairs with sales/doanh số ambiguity between purchase revenue and purchase-row count. The original 15 missing-period pairs are preserved verbatim and receive only source/language/scope metadata.
protocol_revision.source_scope_contract: Every clarification case has ui_scope: [source_id]. The same source is visible in both systems' user input; the candidate must not be scored on source guessing.
protocol_revision.metric_ambiguity_contract: The revised ambiguous term is sales/doanh số, which can mean monetary revenue or a count of purchase events/item lines. The explicit controls state either purchase revenue or purchase-row count. Olist purchase count is item-line grain.
protocol_revision.preserved_cases: The 15 original missing-period prompts, hidden time_range intents, SQL, and gold results are preserved from research_v3/interactions.yaml. Added fields only: source_id, language, ui_scope.
protocol_revision.replaced_cases: The 15 invalid customer-count ambiguity/control pairs are replaced by 15 paired sales metric ambiguity/control scenarios with independent gold for all worlds.

dataset.provenance: Three SQL fixtures are copied from challenge_v1. Independent gold SQL and Python row aggregation are provided by the copied gold_oracle.py, which imports the challenge_v1 synthetic source-row generator. No Texa QuerySpec/compiler or LLM is used to generate the expected answers. The 15 retained time pairs are copied from the frozen research_v3 candidate and receive no question/gold changes.
dataset.limitations: Synthetic controlled worlds do not estimate accuracy on production sources. Sales can remain context-sensitive even when revenue and purchase-row count are legitimate interpretations; two independent reviewers must verify naturalness and that the resolver should ask rather than select a default. Candidate is unsealed and must not support confirmatory claims.
